## Summary
Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation
- [ ] Feature-specific automated test added or updated
- [ ] Lint, type checks, unit tests and production build pass
- [ ] Playwright smoke tests pass for the main user path
- [ ] Tested the actual preview deployment after CI passed
- [ ] If there is a scrollable panel, tested scrolling fully down and back up
- [ ] Checked that interactions do not unexpectedly scroll or trap the outer page
- [ ] Reset, close/cancel and repeated-open flows tested where applicable
- [ ] Checked a desktop viewport and a narrow/mobile viewport
- [ ] Documentation and known limitations updated

## Manual smoke-test notes
Record the preview URL, viewport size, steps performed, and any issue found. A green build alone is not proof that the interaction works.

## Performance / accessibility
Note any relevant performance, keyboard, focus, reduced-motion or accessibility checks. Do not claim a performance target without measuring it on reference hardware.
